verdict.rationale: incident.io documents several built-in AI capabilities that take work off responders. Investigations is an agent that 'does the legwork a responder normally would'. The changelog says you 'can now update your status page using the agent'. Suggestions automatically drafts updates, summaries and follow-up actions, and post-mortem AI generates drafts and redrafts sections. However, there is little evidence of a general-purpose in-product assistant that users can hand arbitrary tasks to, so coverage of the delegation story is partial. Missing for 10: documentation of a general in-product assistant interface for delegating arbitrary tasks, detail on the agent-driven actions beyond status page updates, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Investigations automatically work out what's going on during an incident, doing the legwork a responder normally would, faster and across every source at once.
You can now update your status page using the agent
Suggestions uses AI to help teams communicate better during incidents by automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions based on your incident activity.
Generate first drafts, get inline review suggestions, and redraft sections with AI.
Collaborate with your team and AI to carefully draft status page updates
